name: After School Wendy's Run
source:
Lynn, Olive, and Dorian just wanted a chill day – but then Elliot shows up with his new boyfriend, Cole. Awkward introductions, gacha games, and riverside mischief turn an ordinary afternoon into unforgettable chaos.

[From [url=https://lesflaya.itch.io/after-school-wendys-run]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
林恩、奥利弗和多里安只是想度过一个轻松的一天，但随后艾略特带着他的新男友科尔出现了。尴尬的介绍、扭蛋游戏和河边的恶作剧将一个平凡的下午变成了令人难忘的混乱。
